parameters.help_en: The site ID. To obtain this ID, call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required for a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required for a global configuration. Valid values:

`on`: Enables the rule.

`off`: Disables the rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The conditional expression that the rule uses to match requests. This parameter is not required for a global configuration.

To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

To match specific requests, provide a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Force HTTPS. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables Force HTTPS.

`off`: Disables Force HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_force

parameters.help_en:
The redirect status code for Force HTTPS. Valid values:

`301`

`302`

`307`

`308`
parameters.help_zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
301
302
307
308
parameters.name: https_force_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the `Alt-Svc` header. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables the Alt-Svc header.

`off`: Disables the Alt-Svc header
parameters.help_zh:
功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the `clear` directive in the `Alt-Svc` header. The directive is not included by default. Valid values:

`on`: Includes the directive.

`off`: Does not include the directive
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_clear

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the `persist` directive in the `Alt-Svc` header. The directive is not included by default. Valid values:

`on`: Includes the directive.

`off`: Does not include the directive
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_persist

parameters.help_en: The max-age for the Alt-Svc header, in seconds. The default is 86400
parameters.help_zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒
parameters.name: alt_svc_ma

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS). This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables HSTS.

`off`: Disables HSTS
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include subdomains in the HSTS policy. Subdomains are not included by default. Valid values:

`on`: Includes subdomains.

`off`: Does not include subdomains
parameters.help_zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_include_subdomains

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS Preload. HSTS Preload is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables Preload.

`off`: Disables Preload
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_preload

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A lower value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI) verification. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Enables SNI verification.

`off`: Disables SNI verification
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_sni_verify

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deny TLS handshake requests that do not include an SNI. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

`on`: Denies requests without an SNI.

`off`: Allows requests without an SNI
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_no_sni_deny

parameters.help_en: The SNI allowlist. Separate multiple hostnames with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔
parameters.name: https_sni_whitelist
